_comment: egirl operator bench. Driven through the real agent via `egirl cli -m ... --json`, so tool registration, config and prompt changes are all in scope. A case passes only if the expected tool was called (or none, for abstention), every arg_check regex matches, no forbid pattern appears, and the run completed. Answering correctly via the wrong tool is a failure. Cases point at ~/Projects/dummy/egirl, a throwaway clone reset before every run — pointing them at the live repo let an agent rewrite config files and delete 117 lines of egirl.example.toml.
